retreat.how: dog-layer centroid moves away >3 px or its top drops >4 px (cowers), from 0.5 s

watch_after_retreat.how: nose rises above the withers past the midpoint between crouched and watching heights

refuse.how: rendered head no longer points to the door (front-view whole frame or head pointing away)

watch_turns_back.how: rendered nose points to the door again (nose left of neck)

approach.how: nose drops >15 px below its watching height above the withers, or centroid moves toward the door >3 px

lie_down.how: dog-layer bbox height falls below 85 % of its standing height

looks_in.how: dog-layer top rises >10 px above its lying height (the head comes up into the doorway)

settles.how: top returns to lying height and the nose is below the withers again
